verdict.rationale: Mistral documents a formal model lifecycle (release → deprecation → retirement, Labs vs GA models) and provides model cards and a /v1/models API for catalog discovery, giving developers a way to track model status changes, but there's no evidence of an actual changelog/release-notes page, versioned API changelog, or subscribable feed for tracking incremental API changes over time. missing for 10: dedicated changelog/release-notes page, API versioning history, subscription mechanism (RSS/email) for change notifications, independent confirmation that these docs are kept current.
